title: Brain Takes a Kitchen Shift!
text: Chef Brain reporting for kitchen duty! Salmon brings DHA, a building block in brain cell membranes!
speaker: Chef Brain

title: Three Simple Ingredients
text: One salmon fillet, one bell pepper, and a teaspoon of oil. Add a little pepper if you like.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01 Pat Dry, Check Bones, Slice
text: Pat the salmon dry and check for bones! Slice the pepper thinly so it cooks alongside the fish.
speaker: Chef Brain

title: 02 Arrange and Lightly Oil
text: Spread everything on an oven-safe tray. Coat lightly with oil and a little pepper.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03 Bake in a Preheated Oven
text: Into an oven preheated to two hundred degrees Celsius! Check after fifteen minutes. Thicker pieces need longer!
speaker: Chef Brain

title: Check the Thickest Center
text: Check that the thickest part of the salmon reaches sixty-three degrees Celsius.
speaker: Narrator

title: Why Brain Chose Salmon
text: Salmon provides DHA, an omega-three fatty acid. DHA is a component of the membranes around brain cells.
speaker: Narrator

title: How Much DHA in This Recipe?
text: The amount shown is estimated from the uncooked salmon. Fish type and cooking conditions can change the amount.
speaker: Narrator

title: Dinner Decision: Solved!
text: One bite will not make you a genius! But I did solve the mystery of what is for dinner!
speaker: Chef Brain

title: Screenshot the Full Recipe
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Brain
